title: exercises for tendinitis (tendonitis) and carpal tunnel (cps)
summary: A short video of stretching and hand exercises for preventing and easing tendinitis and carpal tunnel syndrome, from a percussion teacher. The exercises were shown to him by a doctor.
why: Frequently recommended in RSI and wrist pain threads by people who say the stretches relieved their own symptoms.

quote.text: This video saved me from debilitating hand and wrist pain.
